mintAuthority.summary: HedgeCore sUSD uses OZ AccessControl. The hUSDC wrapper contract (0x34EEa40FB…) holds MINTER_ROLE; DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE is held by EOA 0x30829883…. MAX_SUPPLY is a Solidity constant at 1B tokens.

controls.label: HedgeCore hUSDC wrapper contract (MINTER_ROLE holder)
controls.capDescription: MAX_SUPPLY is a Solidity constant (≈1B tokens); issueFromWrapper() requires MINTER_ROLE and checks MAX_SUPPLY.
controls.evidence: At BSC block 103632643, hasRole(MINTER_ROLE, 0x34eea40fb819bfc762b836dd6269f975227794d3) returned true. wrapper() on sUSD returns the same address, cross-confirming the on-chain wrapper. eth_getCode on 0x34eea… returned 5674-byte contract. MAX_SUPPLY() = 1B tokens (immutable Solidity constant, no setter).

controls.label: HedgeCore DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE (EOA)
controls.evidence: At BSC block 103632643, hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, 0x30829883394adfc36f95a84881be1254f60bdd35) returned true. Also confirmed as wrapper() owner(). eth_getCode on 0x30829… returned empty bytecode (EOA). This EOA can grantRole/revokeRole to change the wrapper minter.

controls.label: HedgeCore operator (USDC deposit / Venus strategy / redemption)
controls.evidence: HedgeCore docs describe an operator running USDC deposit, Venus lending strategy, and operator-controlled early redemption; wrapper mint is gated behind this operator-controlled flow.

review.evidence: At BSC block 103632643: hasRole(MINTER_ROLE, wrapper 0x34eea40fb…) = true; hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, EOA 0x30829883…) = true; wrapper() = 0x34eea40fb… (confirmed cross-match). 0x30829883… is EOA (empty bytecode). MAX_SUPPLY() = 1B (immutable constant, no setter function). HedgeCore docs confirm soul-bound soul mechanism and operator redemption flow. The token and wrapper are non-upgradeable, the 1 billion sUSD ceiling is a Solidity constant, and no authority can raise it; the direct mint call is therefore economically bounded.
